A340E (2JZ-GTE) AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION - COMPONENT PARTS REMOVAL

SST

AT5127

29. REMOVE SECOND COAST BRAKE COVER, PISTON
ASSEMBLY AND SPRING
(a) Using SST, remove the snap ring.
SST 09350-30020 (09350-07060)

AT5280

(b) Applying compressed air to the oil hole, remove the se-
cond cost brake cover, piston assembly and spring.

AT5086

(c) Remove the 2 O-rings from the cover.

AT5149

30. REMOVE DIRECT CLUTCH WITH FORWARD CLUTCH
(a) Remove the direct clutch with forward clutch from the
case.

Forward Clutch          Direct Clutch

AT5262

(b) Remove the direct clutch from the forward clutch.
